planets.name: HD 95338 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 95338 with a 55.1-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: HD 95338 b was found in 2020 by Las Campanas Observatory as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 95338. Its orbit and size follow Kálmán et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
